title: Canonical Hero raw skill lifecycle and authorized V1 preservation policy
rules: CharacterHero is the sole canonical owner of six raw skill levels and six raw override IDs. Store them with the existing Hero; Pet skills retain their accepted owner and lifecycle. No PublicProfile copy becomes gameplay truth.

Fresh Hero acquisition and prepared materialization atomically seed six raw levels of 1 and six zero no-override IDs under policy I7C2A_V1_RAW_SKILL_SEED_V1. Backfill only missing V2 skill facts; preserve explicit nondefault facts, identity, allocator, unrelated progression and immutable historical operation outcomes. This is a directly authorized V1 reconstruction policy, not original-server initialization proof.

Raw levels/IDs remain distinct from source-derived offsets, color/awakening unlocks, ordinary/default skill IDs, basic attack level and twice-awake progression. Source-absent content cannot be replaced by a guessed default or an unavailable provider reported as qualified absence.

Selected special producer MID2144 reuses the approved V1 KongMing policy: owned awakened Hero11001144, slot5, exact five book-to-skill mappings, positive owned book quantity as a nonconsuming gate, canonical six-ID response. Use existing I5 inventory owner through typed transaction ports; no foreign SQL or independent nested transaction.

Use inherited actor/lifecycle fencing, player/Hero/resource lock order, captured-time discipline, owner-version CAS and semantic request fingerprint/receipt recovery. Replaying an old or new operation returns its saved outcome even if live skill state changed; never substitute a live reread for the original receipt.

Bootstrap/MID49 and coherent Character/Showcase reads project real canonical raw facts after qualification. Content-qualified derived IDs are a separate typed observation with explicit revision/profile. Raw fact qualification does not accept stat/force, full Showcase, histories, I7C or I7.

MID53/39 skill-level increases and skill-point purchase/recovery remain explicit adjacent future owner routes under existing I5/Temporal contracts unless subsequently selected by a justified amendment. This minimal raw-fact and KongMing choice stage does not waive later scope or activate these commands. New contrary source/profile/contract evidence must be reported for the user decision under the approved V1 policy route.
acceptance_obligations: Real PostgreSQL fresh/upgrade/acquisition/materialization/choice/reload atomicity and receipt recovery
Affected inherited source/owner/transaction/projection regressions on the exact candidate using portable R2
Independent changed-contract/source reality check; parent exit remains separate
scope_limit: No product implementation or acceptance. No general skill-point economy or full battle-stat compiler in this leaf.
